about: Every text-rule site that tests/test_no_text_rules.py collects from src/ and scripts/verify_circe_delivery.py, keyed by (file, fingerprint). A site missing from this list fails the guard.
inventory: docs/inventory/2026-10-12_text_rules.md and .json (repo state ec0cf51; src/ unchanged at 7c63c6d)

kinds.pending: an inventoried (or newly found) text rule, or a site that exists only inside one, scheduled for removal; delete the entry when the code is gone, and never add a new one
kinds.allowed: machine-format parsing or a structured enum / field name (inventory class B, rule 4); the reason says which

inventory_id.A*, S*, C*, D*, E*: the inventory row the site belongs to
inventory_id.B*: the inventory's class-B file entry for the file the site is in
inventory_id.new:B: allowed site in a file the inventory did not list; classified when this ledger was built
inventory_id.new:dead: Class-A-shaped rule the inventory did not list, off the delivery path; classified when this ledger was built
